show_hn.title: Show HN: Guess the Majority's Opinion in a GPT-4-Powered Daily iPhone Game

quotes.text:
Plura is an iPhone game where you compete with users from around the world to get to the top of the leaderboard. Every day, you'll receive three light-hearted, opinion-based questions generated by GPT-4. Your goal is to choose the answers that you think the majority of players will also pick.

The game is not only about intuition but also speed. While you earn points based on your ability to align with the majority, you lose points for taking too long to answer. The quicker you answer, the more points you can earn.

In addition to competing with users from around the world on the global leaderboard, Plura offers the ability to create and join groups. Groups enable you to compare your daily, weekly, monthly, and all time scores with your friends.

Plura is available for download for free from the App Store. I look forward to hearing what the HN community thinks of my game!
